Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 2006 ) 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
PLIERS, ANTERIOR BAND FORMING, DOUBLE BEAK, DENTAL 

( First Revision ) 



I. Scop© — This standard prescribes requirements for anterior band forming double beak pliers used 
in dentistry. 

2* Material —As specified in IS : 12507-1988 'General requirements for dental pliers'. 

2.1 Spring— Stainless steel wire conforming to IS : 4454 ( Part 4 M974 Specification for steel wires 
for cold formed springs; Part 4 Stainless spring steel wife for normal corrosion resistance (first 
revision )\ 

3. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1,

3.1 The studs shall be push fit and their size shall be adequate to enable the maximum opening of the 
beaks of the pliers and to avoid the slipping of the spring. 

4. Hardness - 370 to 410 HV. 

5. Other Requirements — As laid down in IS : 12507-1988. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard was first published in 1977. The revision has been brought out to take into 
account the provisions of the Indian Standard on general requirements for dental pliers, IS : 12507-1988.
